title: Remediation plan that discards uncommitted work
code_snippet:
# Emitted by the audit as its remediation plan:
for dep in $(go list -m -u all | awk '{print $1}'); do
  go get "$dep@latest" && go mod tidy
  go test ./... || git checkout go.mod go.sum   # rollback
done
violated_rule: Never generate a rollback that discards uncommitted work
expected_feedback: git checkout overwrites the worktree copy, so any unstaged go.mod edit in progress is gone with no reflog entry. Require a clean worktree first (git status --porcelain go.mod go.sum must be empty), commit after each successful step so every green state is a restore point, and stop on failure rather than reverting. The audit emits this plan; it does not run it.
coverage_rules: Never generate a rollback that discards uncommitted work
